notes: #3’s record dates it 1890–1905 and describes it as “Kronstadt um 1900”, so it is labeled about 1900; the print code P.Z. is Photoglob Zürich. #2 (from the Rattenberg, same series) and #4 (Muschalek photo, about 1890) are alternative P4 views. #5, #6, #8 are 1944 bombing photos with the city hidden under smoke. #7 is kept as the only 20th-century view that shows the town; drop it if the tree trunks are too intrusive.
